description: This file defines the ActiveUserBillingService class, which manages active user counts, user details, and bookings for organizations and platform subscriptions within a billing context. It interacts with a repository to fetch user activity data and provides methods for counting and retrieving active users and their bookings.

classes.name: ActiveUserBillingService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to count and retrieve active users and bookings for organizations and platform subscriptions.

methods.name: getActiveUserCountForPlatformOrg
methods.description: Counts active users (hosts + attendees) for a platform organization based on subscription ID within a period.

methods.name: getActiveUserCountForOrg
methods.description: Counts active users (hosts + attendees) for a regular organization based on org ID within a period.

methods.name: getActiveUsersForOrg
methods.description: Retrieves detailed active user breakdown (hosts and attendees) for an organization within a period.

methods.name: getBookingsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves bookings for a user, either as host or attendee, within a period.

methods.name: countActiveUsers
methods.description: Helper method to count active users from a list of candidate emails within a period.
